displayName: Lurk – Twitch streams in your sidebar
description: Watch Twitch livestreams and past broadcasts in a small VS Code panel, with chat, 7TV emotes and the channels you follow.
config.followRaids: When the channel you are watching raids someone, switch to the raided channel automatically.
config.quality: Preferred stream quality. The quality menu in the player overrides this until VS Code restarts.
config.quality.auto: Pick the best quality for the panel size and bandwidth.
config.resumeLastChannel: Reopen the last watched channel when the player panel is shown after VS Code starts.
config.chat.maxMessages: How many chat messages to keep in the chat panel.
welcome.following:
Sign in with your Twitch account to see which of the channels you follow are live and to chat.
[Sign in with Twitch](command:twitchPlayer.signIn)
Lurk reads the channels you follow and your emotes, and sends only the messages you write.
config.twitchClientId: Client ID of your own [Twitch application](https://dev.twitch.tv/console/apps) (client type *Public*) to sign in with. Leave empty to use Lurk's.
